metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect burned forest areas in Sakha (Yakutia, Russia) for 2015 and 2021 - Use MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1) which provides monthly burned area at 500m resolution - Sakha Republic boundaries can be defined using FAO GAUL or a rough bounding box - Date ranges: Full years 2015 (Jan-Dec) and 2021 (Jan-Dec) 2. Masking strategy: - MCD64A1 has a BurnDate band where values 1-366 indicate day of year burned, 0 = unburned - Need to mask to only burned pixels (BurnDate > 0) - Should also consider forest mask using MODIS Land Cover or similar 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: - If burned area is truly 0 in either year = valid result (answer A or B) - If collection is empty = C1 - If no valid pixels after processing = C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN = C3 - Compare total burned area: 2015 > 2021 = A (Yes), otherwise = B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sakha Republic geometry (approximate bounding box) const sakha = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([105, 55, 165, 75]); // 2. Load burned area data for both years const burned2015 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2015-01-01', '2015-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha) .select('BurnDate'); const burned2021 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha) .select('BurnDate'); // Check if collections are empty const size2015 = burned2015.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = burned2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2015 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log('Empty collection detected'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Create annual burned area masks (any pixel burned during the year) const burnMask2015 = burned2015.max().gt(0); const burnMask2021 = burned2021.max().gt(0); // 4. Calculate burned area (count of burned pixels * pixel area) // MODIS is 500m resolution = 0.25 km² per pixel const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); // Convert to km² const burnedArea2015 = burnMask2015.multiply(pixelArea); const burnedArea2021 = burnMask2021.multiply(pixelArea); // 5. Sum total burned area for each year const area2015Result = burnedArea2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2021Result = burnedArea2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Count valid pixels const count2015Result = burnMask2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2021Result = burnMask2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2015 = area2015Result.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const area2021 = area2021Result.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const count2015 = count2015Result.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const count2021 = count2021Result.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Burned Area: ${area2015 ? area2015.toFixed(2) : 'null'} km², Pixels: ${count2015 || 0}`); console.log(`2021 Burned Area: ${area2021 ? area2021.toFixed(2) : 'null'} km², Pixels: ${count2021 || 0}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (area2015 === null || area2021 === null || isNaN(area2015) || isNaN(area2021)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (count2015 === 0 && count2021 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in either year'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare burned areas if (area2015 > area2021) { console.log('More forest burned in 2015 than 2021'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2021 had equal or more burned area than 2015'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
